The '''''Nevoota Bee''''' was a [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] participated in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], where it served in the role of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], loaded with 156 [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. The vessel carried [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], into battle. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led force won the engagement, capturing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for the Republic.

==Description==
The ''[[Nevoota (planet)|Nevoota]] Bee'' was an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] constructed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] for use in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Measuring 752 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from stem to stern, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was armed with twelve quad [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, twenty-four anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and four bow-mounted missile tubes. Equipped with a 0.6 Class [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], the ''[[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]] Bee'', like its sister ships, was designed to travel swiftly to a battlefield and deploy a large number of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The ''Nevoota Bee'' carried at least twenty [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]], mainly stored in overhead racks,<ref name="CW2" /> but was optimized as a starfighter [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], carrying 156 [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] on its vehicle decks.<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
[[File:Acclamatorsarrive.jpg|thumb|left|275px|A fleet of ''Acclamator''-class assault ships arrive above Muunilinst.]]
With the eruption of the Clone Wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Rothana Heavy Engineering&mdash;a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]&mdash;was responsible for manufacturing the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and ground vehicles used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], including ''Acclamator''-class assault ships. Although designed primarily as troop [[Transport/Legends|transports]], the Republic found the versatile ships able to conform to other mission profiles, including command ships, mobile depots, and [[Commando/Legends|commando]] insertion platforms. The ''Nevoota Bee'' was one such Acclamator that served a mission profile other than it was designed for, operating as a starfighter carrier with one hundred and fifty-six V-19 Torrents stationed aboard.<ref name="EGTW" />

Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the Republic authorized an [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|assault]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] who were a major member state of the Confederacy.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The ''Nevoota Bee'',<ref name="EGTW" /> along with hundreds of other vessels, ferried the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] army and starfighter forces to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="NEC" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], were aboard the ''Nevoota Bee'',<ref name="CW2" /><ref name="TFNPU">{{JCFCite|url=posts/84148|board=Literature|thread=BE EXCITED: The Essential Thread to The Essential Guide to Warfare|user=[[Paul R. Urquhart|Thrawn Mcewok]]|date=2012-04-30|temp=yes|nobackup=1}} &ndash; Paul Urquhart confirms that the ''Nevoota Bee'' mentioned in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' is the same vessel that Anakin Skywalker was aboard in [[Chapter 2 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Clone Wars Chapter 2]].</ref> and both would be commanding elements of the Republic's assault force; Kenobi would lead the [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]], while Skywalker would command the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] starfighter force.<ref name="CW1">{{CW|1}}</ref> As the battle commenced, the ''Nevoota Bee''{{'s}} complement of V-19's, led by Skywalker in his [[Azure Angel|personal]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], poured out of the ''Acclamator''{{'s}} launch bay and engaged a force of Separatist [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform|gun platforms]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighters defending the planet. Soon after, the assault ship's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] launched, ferrying Kenobi and [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers to the surface.<ref name="CW2" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led clone army won the battle, securing Muunilinst for the Republic.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
The ''Nevoota Bee'' was first referenced in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' in [[2012]], and was linked to the Battle of Muunilinst, an engagement that featured prominently in the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' series. In endnotes for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' posted on his personal Tumblr, Fry states that the naming of the ''Nevoota Bee'' was both an homage to the World War Two aircraft carriers [[Wikipedia:USS Hornet (CV-12)|''Hornet'']] and [[Wikipedia:USS Wasp (CV-18)|''Wasp'']], and a reference to an in-joke from the Star Wars online community in the 1990s.<ref name="WarfareEndnotes5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>

The ''Nevoota Bee'' was confirmed by coauthor [[Paul R. Urquhart|Paul Urquhart]] to be the same vessel that Anakin Skywalker and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] take off from in the [[Chapter 2 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|second episode]] of the ''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' animated series. He stated that he envisioned the Torrent starfighters as being packed onto the hangar deck similar to [[Wikipedia:North American B-25 Mitchell|B-25s]] during the [[Wikipedia:Doolittle Raid|Doolittle Raid]] in World War Two.<ref name="TFNPU" />

===The "Nevoota Bee" joke===
{{Quote|It never ceases to bring a smile to my face&mdash;what started as a sarcastic comment from Tom, an April Fools' Day joke from me, and an in-joke from Mike has actually evolved into a long-lost chapter of Star Wars lore.|Rich Handley|<ref name="Citewebshavenwookie">{{WebCite|url=http://www.shavenwookie.com/orhp/humour/palbacca.txt|text=Palbacca and the Neevoota Bees|author=[[Rich Handley]]|date=1999-10-27|work=www.shavenwookie.com|archivedate=20080331054009}}</ref>}}
The term "Nevoota Bee" originated as an in-joke between [[Tom Veitch]], author of several ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series; [[Rich Handley]], author of several ''Star Wars'' articles; and [[Mike Beidler]], author of the ''[http://webspace.webring.com/people/vm/mikebeidler/starwarsliteraturecompendium/nr3empire.html Star Wars Literature Compendium]'' fansite. Veitch reportedly was once asked "What is that buzzing noise in the background of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]?," to which he replied, "The Nevoota Bee"&mdash;in reality, the noise was likely caused by a bad copy of the film. In an unrelated incident, Handley posted an April Fool's Day joke on rec.arts.sf.starwars.misc which announced that a sequel to ''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]'' was being released which involved [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] being reborn inside an insane clone of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] named Palbacca. Beidler then took the two references and combined them, listing the fictional "Scourge of the Nevoota Bee" trilogy on his website. Accompanied by a fifty-part comic series, it was purported to be written by Veitch and Beidler, with the audiobook renditions read by Handley. The joke circulated throughout the online Star Wars fan community.<ref name="JCF1">{{JCFCite|url=posts/18104880|board=Literature|thread=Insider #80 to feature Mandalorian article, Yo Joe!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2005-01-19|time=11:38 AM}}</ref><ref name="Citewebshavenwookie" />

The planet Nevoota was introduced to Star Wars [[canon]] in [[1998]] in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', while the Nevoota species were first introduced by [[Abel G. Peña]] in the article [[The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors|''The History of the Mandalorians'']], published in [[Star Wars Insider 80]] in [[2005]]. The species, a race of intelligent insects, was confirmed to be a nod to the long-running "Nevoota Bee" joke by Peña in a post of the [[Jedi Council Forums]].<ref name="JCF2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/18101153|board=Literature|thread=Insider #80 to feature Mandalorian article, Yo Joe!|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2005-01-18|time=11:32 PM}}</ref>
